solverHints.useExpectedValue: For probabilistic ROI, expectedValue = value * probability.
solverHints.mobileHazards: Avoid cells near mobile hazard timed frames when possible.
solverHints.depth: Shallow depth can increase energy cost when mission rules enable depth effects.
solverHints.ensemble: High ensemble disagreement indicates forecast uncertainty; risk-aware solvers may penalize it.
solverHints.endCondition: Check missionRules.endCondition to see whether final surfacing, communication, or recovery is required or rewarded.
solverHints.sampling: Check missionRules.sampling before revisiting ROI cells; duplicate, depleted, cooldown, or persistent samples may score differently.
solverHints.priorityTargets: Gold Star Targets are temporal high-value objectives. Capture them only while active and within radius.
solverHints.navigationUncertainty: When enabled, dead-reckoning cones grow underwater until surfacing/GPS correction; penalize routes whose cone overlaps land or hazards.
solverHints.planningMarkers: planningData.planningMarkers are player notes for future windows; they are not executable waypoints.

planningData.notes: Perfect knowledge mode: truth fields are visible planning data.

graphSearch.adjacency: Construct 4-neighbor or 8-neighbor adjacency from terrain/traversability masks.
graphSearch.costModel: Use agent speed/fuel plus temporal current frames to derive travel time, energy, hazard, and risk costs.
graphSearch.state: cell, optional time/frame, optional fuel, optional sampled-target set

multiAgentPlanning.sharedReward: ROI and priority target rewards are team-level; duplicate sampling behavior is defined by missionRules.sampling.
multiAgentPlanning.conflictConstraints: No hard collision constraint by default; external planners may add spacing or overlap penalties.

reinforcementLearning.actionSpace: choose deployment start when required, then waypoint cell/time/action decisions
reinforcementLearning.reward: score summary components from missionRules and scoring rules
reinforcementLearning.termination: mission duration, route failure, fuel/time exhaustion, or mission end condition

supervisedLearning.labels: Use imported/manual/baseline plans and result trajectories when present.
supervisedLearning.returnsToGo: Derive from result scoreSummary or run external evaluator on candidate plans.

neuralPlanning.tensors: Grid layers are exported as nested arrays; temporal frame arrays are ordered by frame t.
neuralPlanning.graphFeatures: Node features can be built from terrain, hazards, ROI, depth, current vector, forecast probability, and priority target activity.
neuralPlanning.sequenceFeatures: Use temporal current/ROI/forecast frames plus agent state and remaining horizon.
